ei.title: Proportion of Student Housing by Accommodation Type

fullPassage: The graph above shows the proportion of student housing by accommodation type for selected study destinations in 2022. Notably, Other Private Accommodations made up the largest share of student housing, except in the UK, where PBSAs were the most common type. Among the study destinations, the UK had the highest percentage of University Accommodations and PBSAs. University Accommodations were used by fewer than one-third of students in every study destination, with Australia showing the lowest proportion. Australia showed the greatest difference between University Accommodations and PBSAs, with a 10-percentage-point gap, while the USA showed the smallest difference, with a 1-percentage-point gap. Europe was the only study destination where the percentage of PBSAs was greater than that of University Accommodations, showing the opposite pattern to the other study destinations.
